en.title: pregabalin: 2.5, Table 2 and 2.5, Table 2 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: 2.5, Table 2 reads “30-60 75 150 225 300 BID or TID”. 2.5, Table 2 reads “15-30 25-50 75 100-150 150 QD or BID”. Example: A patient with creatinine clearance exactly 30 mL/min matches both rows, with different total daily doses and regimens. The same text is in 225 labels from 60 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
